initial_access: GitHub account of keyv maintainer (jaredwray) compromised; malicious commit pushed to main, releases cut through GitHub Actions. Poisoned versions therefore carry valid npm provenance attestations - provenance is not a defense here, it attests the build, not the source.

package_list.format: csv: Package,"Malicious Versions" (comma-separated versions per row)
package_list.completeness: PARTIAL AND MOVING. Counts differ by vendor (JFrog 428 pkgs/1700+ versions, Cloudsmith ~444/2236, Aikido 868/1381) because the worm republishes every package writable with each stolen credential set. Re-pull before trusting a zero result.

execution_chain.primary: npm install -> package.json preinstall hook -> node setup.mjs -> downloads Bun 1.3.13 from the official GitHub release -> executes math_init.js (aka Math_Symbol.js) under Bun
execution_chain.secondary: Repo open in IDE/agent -> autostart hook in .vscode/tasks.json or .claude/settings.json -> same loader. Requires NO npm install.
execution_chain.npm_12_caveat: npm >= 12 does not run preinstall lifecycle hooks by default, so the primary chain does not fire there. Those environments stay exposed through the secondary chain. A detection keyed only on npm execution misses this entirely.
execution_chain.propagation: Downloads the current latest tarball of each package writable with stolen credentials, copies itself to package/math_init.js, writes package/setup.mjs, replaces the whole scripts object with preinstall=node setup.mjs, republishes with an incremented patch version.

file_hashes_sha256.component: payload variant observed in internal hunt window

ethereum.role: Resolves the live C2 address from an on-chain read, so blocking a single domain does not sever control. Treat the RPC providers above as the chokepoint.

credential_targets: cloud provider credentials (AWS/GCP/Azure) present in CI env

detection_notes.version_precision_required: keyv, cacheable, flat-cache, file-entry-cache and cacheable-request are extremely common legitimate packages. Alerting on package NAME produces mass false positives. Only name+version matches are actionable.
detection_notes.where_versions_are_visible: Lockfiles (package-lock.json / pnpm-lock.yaml / yarn.lock) and registry proxy logs. NOT reliably visible in EDR telemetry: a process command line shows only what the developer typed, and node_modules paths carry no version.
highest_fidelity_endpoint_signals: Bun execution on a host with no legitimate Bun usage
writes to .claude/ or .vscode/ inside a repo working tree that create setup.mjs or math_init.js
outbound contact to the Ethereum RPC providers from a node/bun process
